readings: Matching each result to its race by `raceId`, group by race name (`races.name`) and compute each race name's total `points` and average `laps`. Keep race names whose total points are greater than the average of those totals across all race names. Return one row with: the sum of the kept race names' total points; the plain average of their per-race-name average laps, each race name counting equally; and the average amount by which their totals exceed the average total.
queries:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(res.points) AS tp, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS al
  FROM results res
  JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
),
m AS (SELECT AVG(tp) AS mt FROM t)
SELECT SUM(t.tp) AS total_points,
       AVG(t.al) AS avg_laps,
       AVG(t.tp - m.mt) AS avg_excess
FROM t, m
WHERE t.tp > m.mt;
